title: The last ordinary week, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. The pup on the beach. A stick. He brings it back. Wood throws it. He brings it back. Four panels, one stick. The last dog-and-stick strip in the run.

panels.composition: The beach, December, gray. BARNABY II with a stick, delivering it. WOOD.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog delivering a stick to a thin man on a gray December beach

panels.composition: The throw. The stick in the air. The dog already going.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man throwing a stick along a beach with a small three-legged dog already running after it

panels.composition: The stick delivered again. Wet now.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small dog delivering a wet stick to a man's hand on a beach

panels.composition: The throw again. The same stick. The same dog. The same man. The strip could do this forever and has four days.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man throwing the same stick along the same beach as a small three-legged dog runs after it again, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: One stick, four panels. The last stick.
